title: Spot CVD chart at 2:00 p.m. UTC on July 28
summary: Spot CVD is an order book analysis chart for the BTC/USDT spot trading pair. The upper section shows the volume heatmap, while the lower section represents cumulative volume delta, or CVD.- The volume heatmap in the upper section tracks trading volume at each price level, and the background color becomes brighter when the price stays in a specific range for an extended period or makes a large move. Areas closer to bright colors may act as support or resistance.- The cumulative volume delta indicator in the lower section reflects buy and sell orders by capital size, and the line for each color rises as buy orders increase. The yellow line represents $100 to $1,000 orders, while the brown line represents large orders worth $1 million to $10 million.

A circuit breaker is a mechanism that temporarily halts trading when the Kospi or Kosdaq drops sharply, with three stages in total. title: U.S. Senate may delay Clarity Act vote until after next week
summary: The U.S. Senate's focus on a Russia sanctions bill and federal nominations has increased the likelihood that a vote on the Clarity Act, a crypto market structure bill, will be pushed back until after next week, CoinDesk reported. The outlet said the Senate's practice of handling only one contentious bill at a time has made it difficult to take up the Clarity Act before other items are cleared. Disagreements also remain over a provision that would restrict cryptocurrency business activities by senior officials, including President Donald Trump. As a result, it remains unclear whether the Senate can act on the bill before its summer recess on Aug. 8, and the wider the disagreements become, the lower the chances of passage in 2026. CoinDesk added that even if the bill clears the Senate, it would still need another House vote and the president's signature.
